hierarchy.live_metric_primary: font-mono text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white drop-shadow-sm
hierarchy.card_title: font-sans text-base font-semibold tracking-wide text-slate-200 uppercase
hierarchy.small_label: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-300

rules.numbers: Always use IBM Plex Mono for numerical values to ensure tabular alignment.
rules.contrast: Ensure small labels use text-slate-300 instead of slate-500 to maintain high readability in the dark theme.

row_1_top_kpis_and_flow.content_top_kpi: Zwei Gruppen: [PV: Heute Gesamt Erzeugt (kWh), Aktuelle Erzeugung (W)] und [Netz: Heute Bezug (kWh), Verbrauch (kWh), Einspeisung (kWh), Aktueller Export (W)]. KEINE Autarkie/Eigenverbrauch.

unified_card.wrapper: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/50 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] p-6 transition-all duration-300
unified_card.glow_effect: Absolute positioned radial gradient div in the top-right corner with 10% opacity matching the domain accent color (e.g., PV yellow, Battery cyan).

status_badges.styling: flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold

units_and_signs.units: Always display units in a smaller font size than the value (text-xl vs text-4xl). Units: W, kW, kWh, V, A, %.
units_and_signs.signs: Show explicit plus (+) for positive values like charging/import, and minus (-) for discharge/export if applicable. Use semantic coloring for signs.

recharts.lines: Increase strokeWidth to 2.5 or 3 for better visibility against dark backgrounds.
recharts.glow: Use CSS filter drop-shadow to give the lines a neon glow (e.g., drop-shadow(0 0 4px currentColor)).
recharts.colors: Bind line colors to the functional accent colors defined in the colors block.
recharts.tooltips: Ensure recharts tooltips use the glassmorphism card styling (bg-slate-900/90, border-slate-700/50).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are writing a React frontend application.
Use JS/JSX for all React components. Do NOT use TSX.
Ensure 'Deutsche Oberfläche' (German labels) is used everywhere.
Maintain the precise visual hierarchy: Huge dominant values, smaller units, muted secondary data.
Implement the animated SVG energy flow diagram for Row 1. It must indicate power flow dynamically.
Implement the 'Top-Kachel' exactly as requested with the specified variables in Row 1.
Ensure NO fully transparent backgrounds on panels—glassmorphism needs a tinted base (bg-slate-900/70) so text is readable.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the Sci-Fi / Control Room aesthetics strongly but cleanly.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Avoid text-align: center on the root app container.
Ensure layering creates depth via distinct z-indexes and drop shadows.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing. Example: data-testid='kpi-pv-total'.
Use standard Radix UI or Shadcn components adapted to the dark glassmorphism aesthetic where complex interactivity is needed.
